purpose: rank8/alpha16 versus rank16/alpha32 with all other training settings fixed

training.initialization: fresh LoRA from frozen original Qwen base; no rank16 adapter resume
training.target_scope: the same 840 matrices as the baseline; no injection-scope change

replacements.reason: exclude RGB content overlap; replace by closest input brightness

evaluation.metric: full RGB PSNR/SSIM at original output size, same original evaluator
evaluation.rule: paired matched-epoch comparisons; report both tasks and metrics, no best-checkpoint search

limitations: six validation examples, not a final test benchmark
rank-dependent initialization may change RNG consumption
